reviews.zh: 我好耐冇試過咁強效嘅潔面產品，呢款可以有效去除皮膚上嘅污垢同油脂。我好鍾意佢，因為佢提供咗好好嘅潔面體驗。佢有令人愉悅嘅香味。我鍾意佢起泡、容易沖走嘅方式。佢可能會令人乾燥，唔適合敏感皮膚。

reviews.text: Cleans well. Non irritating. Slight citrus fragrance. I have acne prone/blackheads/leave pores/sensitive/combo skin type. I easily break out and this stuff is gentle yet effective at cleaning the days dirty, sunscreen away
reviews.zh: 清潔效果好。唔刺激。微微柑橘香味。我嘅皮膚類型係易生暗瘡／黑頭／毛孔明顯／敏感／混合性。我好易爆痘，但係呢款好温和，又有效噉清走一日嘅污垢、防曬同油脂。

reviews.text: I bought this for my husband, although I have used it myself a few times. Overall, a really good cleanser. Cleanse as well, is gentle, and non-inflammatory. He has dryer skin with the occasional blemishes due to food, sensitivity, and facial hair. I have combination and sensitive skin. It works equally well for both of us. The only reason I’m not giving it five stars is because it doesn’t have some of the added properties that might go to cleanser has. I prefer something with a HA, BHA, or salicylic acid. Really no complaints about this one. A bonus is that it smells really good and refreshing in the mornings when you’re taking a shower before work.
reviews.zh: 我買畀我老公，不過我自己都用過幾次。整體嚟講，係一款非常好嘅潔面產品。清潔效果好，温和，無刺激發炎。佢嘅皮膚比較乾，偶爾因為食物、敏感同鬚髮有啲暗瘡。我嘅皮膚係混合同敏感。對我哋兩個都一樣有效。我冇畀五粒星嘅唯一原因，係佢冇一啲潔面產品可能有嘅附加功能。我比較鍾意有 HA、BHA 或者水楊酸嘅產品。真係冇咩投訴，呢款都好好。最好嘅係佢好香，早上洗澡準備返工嗰陣好清新。

reviews.text: This cleansing cream is fantastic! It removes makeup and impurities effortlessly while leaving my skin feeling soft and hydrated. The creamy texture feels luxurious and doesn't strip my skin, making it perfect for daily use without dryness.
reviews.zh: 呢款潔面霜超好！佢可以毫不費力噉卸除化妝同污垢，同時令我皮膚感覺柔軟、水潤。乳霜質地好豐潤，唔會剝奪皮膚，每日用都好好，唔會乾燥。

reviews.text: I love this cleanser so much. It has a thick consistency and foams incredibly well, a little definitely goes a long way. Beware if you have sensitive skin, it is not the gentlest formula. For anyone with combination/oily skin, this is an excellent option.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款潔面產品。質地好厚，好易起泡，一點點就已經夠用。如果你皮膚敏感要留意，佢唔係最温和嘅配方。對於混合性／油性皮膚嘅人嚟講，呢款係好好嘅選擇。

reviews.text:
I've been using the Goodal - Green Tangerine Vita C Cleansing Foam as part of my complete Goodal skincare routine, which includes the serum, sunscreen, and moisturizer. Together, they've transformed my skincare regimen into something truly remarkable.

This cleansing foam has quickly become an essential starting point for my skincare routine. It effectively removes impurities and leaves my skin feeling refreshed without any dryness or tightness. The green tangerine extract adds a refreshing citrusy scent that I adore.

What I appreciate most is the addition of vitamin C, which complements the other Goodal products I use. It enhances the overall radiance and vibrancy of my skin. As part of a complete skincare routine, this cleansing foam contributes to a healthy, glowing complexion.

The Goodal - Green Tangerine Vita C Cleansing Foam is the perfect accompaniment to a comprehensive Goodal skincare lineup. It not only cleanses effectively but also adds a refreshing touch to my daily routine. If you're considering a full skincare regimen, exploring the Goodal range is a fantastic choice.
reviews.zh:
我一直用緊 Goodal - Green Tangerine Vita C Cleansing Foam，作為我完整 Goodal 護膚系列嘅一部分，當中包括精華、防曬同保濕霜。加埋一齊，佢哋令我嘅護膚步驟變得非常出色。

呢款潔面泡沫好快成為我護膚步驟嘅必需起點。佢可以有效去除污垢，令皮膚感覺清爽，冇乾燥或者緊繃。綠色柑橘萃取帶嚟清新嘅柑橘香味，我好鍾意。

我最欣賞嘅係佢加入咗維他命 C，同我用緊嘅其他 Goodal 產品配合得好好。佢提升咗皮膚嘅整體光采同活力。作為完整護膚步驟嘅一部分，呢款潔面泡沫有助皮膚健康、有光澤。

Goodal - Green Tangerine Vita C Cleansing Foam 係一個完整 Goodal 系列嘅完美配搭。佢唔單止能有效潔面，仲為我嘅日常護膚增添清新感。如果你考慮一套完整護膚程序，探索 Goodal 系列係一個好選擇。

reviews.text: I have combination skin and I used it for two days at night only, and I had pimples on my forehead, not those big pills, just like closed commodores / maybe the foam not for me 🤍
reviews.zh: 我係混合皮膚，我只用咗兩晚，喺晚上用，結果額頭上面長咗暗瘡，唔係嗰啲大粒嘅膿包，只係好似閉口咁，可能係嗰款泡沫唔啱我 🤍

reviews.text: This cleanser cleans really well and does not irritate my skin despite having some citrus oils in it. It smells nice and you do not need a lot of the product to clean your skin. This will last quite a while!
reviews.zh: 呢款潔面產品清潔力好好，雖然含有一啲柑橘類精油，但係唔會刺激我嘅皮膚。味道好好聞，清潔皮膚唔需要用好多。可以用好耐！
